sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt:
USE OF PROCEEDS The net proceeds to us from this offering are estimated to be approximately €8.96 billion, after deducting underwriting discounts and
estimated offering expenses payable by us. We intend to use the net proceeds from this offering for general corporate purposes. Settlement of this offering is not conditioned upon settlement of the Concurrent Securities Offering or vice versa. There can be no assurance
that such offering will be completed. The Concurrent Securities Offering would only be made pursuant to a separate prospectus supplement. This prospectus supplement is not an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any securities being

sections.title: Risk Factors
sections.excerpt:
Risk Factors Investing in the notes involves risk. You should read the “Risk Factors” section of this prospectus supplement and in our latest Quarterly
Report on Form 10-Q, and other periodic reports we have filed and may file with the SEC from time to time, for a discussion of S-6 Table of Contents factors to which you should refer and carefully consider prior to making an investment in the notes. Trading The notes are new issues of securities with no established trading markets. We intend to apply to list each series of the notes on Nasdaq. The listing application will be subject to approval by Nasdaq. We currently expect trading in each series
